appearances.title: GitHub Copilot Fusion goes GA: picks and chains Claude and GPT models per task; AA scores it 2 points under Claude Code with Opus 5.5 at about half the cost
appearances.summary: Announced at GitHub Universe. You choose an effort level (Standard, High, Max) instead of a model, and Fusion routes, escalates or cross-reviews across Anthropic and OpenAI models. On the Artificial Analysis Coding Agent Index, Fusion Max scored 60 vs 62 for Claude Code with Opus 5.5 Max, at $5.59 vs $11.42 per task with about half the tokens. The weak spot is FrontierCode (51 vs 56). Billing foll
